pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How many books are in the whole Bible? (1 mark)
   A. 39
   B. 100
   C. 66
   D. 27

2. What is the meaning of "bless" in this story? (1 mark)
   A. To insult
   B. To ignore
   C. To speak good things over someone
   D. To curse

3. What animal attacked Samson near Timnah? (1 mark)
   A. A young lion
   B. A bear
   C. A snake
   D. A wolf

4. What did Samson's set-apart life to God mean he must never do? (1 mark)
   A. Go to Timnah
   B. Eat honey
   C. Visit his parents
   D. Cut his hair

5. Abram travelled from Haran to Canaan, which lies to the south-west of Haran. In which direction did he travel? (1 mark)
   A. North
   B. North-east
   C. South-west
   D. East

6. Who went with Abram to Canaan? (1 mark)
   A. Isaac
   B. Moses
   C. Sarai and Lot
   D. Joseph

7. What kind of life did Zechariah and Elizabeth lead? (1 mark)
   A. Wicked
   B. Righteous before God
   C. Selfish
   D. Lazy

8. Why could Zechariah not speak for a time? (1 mark)
   A. He was ill
   B. He was sad
   C. He was tired
   D. He did not believe the angel's words

9. What was Bartimaeus' problem? (1 mark)
   A. He was lame
   B. He was blind
   C. He was a leper
   D. He was deaf

10. What did Jesus ask about the other nine? (1 mark)
   A. Who are they?
   B. Who healed them?
   C. Why were they sick?
   D. Where are the other nine?

11. What does gratitude mean? (1 mark)
   A. Boasting
   B. Showing thanks
   C. Complaining
   D. Being angry

12. What should you do before going to an unfamiliar place to help someone? (1 mark)
   A. Tell your parents or teacher
   B. Go secretly
   C. Take valuables
   D. Go at night

13. What is the mustard seed like in size? (1 mark)
   A. As big as an egg
   B. Medium
   C. Very large
   D. Very small

14. Which of these is a trusted person at school? (1 mark)
   A. Your class teacher
   B. A person who offers gifts
   C. A stranger at the gate
   D. Someone who asks for secrets

15. Who was obedient to his parents at Nazareth? (1 mark)
   A. Balaam
   B. Jesus
   C. Jonah
   D. Samson

16. Which command did Jesus give in John 13:34? (1 mark)
   A. Love one another
   B. Fast
   C. Go to the temple
   D. Give money

17. Which of these shows love at school? (1 mark)
   A. Hiding books
   B. Laughing at new pupils
   C. Refusing to greet
   D. Welcoming a new pupil

18. Why is it important to care for personal items? (1 mark)
   A. They are free
   B. They last longer and save money
   C. They look bad
   D. They are unimportant

19. Which is a sin? (1 mark)
   A. Praying
   B. Helping
   C. Stealing
   D. Sharing

20. Who ran away from a wrong situation and was wise? (1 mark)
   A. Joseph
   B. Zacchaeus
   C. Nicodemus
   D. Balaam

21. Which of these is a way of serving God in church? (1 mark)
   A. Helping to clean
   B. Talking during prayers
   C. Breaking chairs
   D. Leaving litter

22. Who was Andrew's brother? (1 mark)
   A. Thomas
   B. John
   C. Philip
   D. Simon Peter

23. Which disciple was a tax collector? (1 mark)
   A. Matthew
   B. Andrew
   C. Peter
   D. Philip

24. Antioch lies north of Jerusalem. In which direction would you travel from Jerusalem to reach Antioch? (1 mark)
   A. North
   B. South
   C. East
   D. West

25. When can Christians pray? (1 mark)
   A. Only in church
   B. Only on Sunday
   C. Only at night
   D. Any time and anywhere

26. Which action shows goodness? (1 mark)
   A. Returning extra change to a shopkeeper
   B. Cheating
   C. Stealing
   D. Lying

27. Why does the Bible say "fruit" and not "fruits"? (1 mark)
   A. The qualities belong together
   B. It is a mistake
   C. There is only one
   D. It refers to mangoes

28. What does self-control mean? (1 mark)
   A. Being lazy
   B. Controlling your words, actions and wishes
   C. Doing whatever you want
   D. Being loud

29. The steps to a right decision are stop, think, pray and choose. Which step comes after thinking? (1 mark)
   A. Forget the problem
   B. Pray
   C. Ask no one
   D. Choose before praying

30. What does Philippians 4:8 encourage us to think about? (1 mark)
   A. Whatever is true, pure and lovely
   B. Whatever hurts
   C. Whatever is unkind
   D. Whatever is false

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Explain what the parable of the mustard seed teaches about God's kingdom. (3 marks)

32. Describe how Abram showed obedience when God called him. (4 marks)

33. List three ways of using money wisely. (3 marks)

34. Describe what a child should do step by step if someone touches them wrongly. (4 marks)

35. Explain how Ephesians 4:25 can be applied by a child in the classroom. (5 marks)

36. Explain how Stephen's forgiving spirit is like that of Jesus and how a child can copy it. (5 marks)

37. Explain why Zechariah was unable to speak. (3 marks)

38. Explain what the story teaches about the power of Jesus and His care for people. (4 marks)

39. Name two people you can trust at home or school. (2 marks)

40. Explain how Proverbs 1:7 helps us to understand why Joseph was so wise. (5 marks)

41. List three activities Christians do in church. (3 marks)

42. Explain the difference between the nuclear family and the extended family, with one example of each member. (4 marks)

43. Give three ways of turning away from sin and living righteously. (3 marks)

44. Where were believers first called Christians? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #18 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — 66
   39 + 27 = 66.

2. C — To speak good things over someone
   To bless is to ask God's good for someone.

3. A — A young lion
   Judges 14:5 says a young lion came roaring towards him.

4. D — Cut his hair
   A Nazirite did not cut his hair.

5. C — South-west
   Canaan is south-west of Haran, so he travelled south-west.

6. C — Sarai and Lot
   Sarai his wife and Lot his nephew went with him.

7. B — Righteous before God
   Luke 1:6 says both were righteous.

8. D — He did not believe the angel's words
   Luke 1:20 says he would be silent because he did not believe.

9. B — He was blind
   Bartimaeus was a blind beggar.

10. D — Where are the other nine?
   Luke 17:17 records the question.

11. B — Showing thanks
   Gratitude is being thankful.

12. A — Tell your parents or teacher
   Safety comes first when helping.

13. D — Very small
   It is one of the smallest seeds.

14. A — Your class teacher
   Teachers help keep children safe.

15. B — Jesus
   Luke 2:51 says Jesus was obedient.

16. A — Love one another
   Jesus said to love as He loved.

17. D — Welcoming a new pupil
   Welcoming is kind.

18. B — They last longer and save money
   Care reduces loss.

19. C — Stealing
   Stealing is taking what is not yours.

20. A — Joseph
   Joseph ran from temptation.

21. A — Helping to clean
   Cleaning is service.

22. D — Simon Peter
   Simon Peter and Andrew were brothers.

23. A — Matthew
   Matthew was a tax collector.

24. A — North
   To reach a place that lies to the north, you travel north.

25. D — Any time and anywhere
   God hears us always.

26. A — Returning extra change to a shopkeeper
   Goodness is doing what is right.

27. A — The qualities belong together
   The nine qualities are one fruit.

28. B — Controlling your words, actions and wishes
   Self-control means governing yourself.

29. B — Pray
   After thinking, we pray, and then we choose.

30. A — Whatever is true, pure and lovely
   Philippians 4:8.

SECTION B
----
31. (3 marks)
   Answer: It began small, with Jesus and a few followers, but it grows large and gives shelter to many.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for small beginning, 1 for growth, 1 for shelter or many people.

32. (4 marks)
   Answer: He left his country, his people and his father's household. He went to a land he did not know. He took his wife, nephew and belongings. He was seventy-five years old.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point up to 4.

33. (3 marks)
   Answer: Save some, spend on needs first, give to those in need, avoid wasting, do not steal or cheat, keep a record.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

34. (4 marks)
   Answer: Say no loudly, move away quickly to a safe place with people, shout for help if needed, tell a trusted adult right away even if told to keep it secret.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step, up to 4.

35. (5 marks)
   Answer: Put off falsehood and speak truthfully because we are all members of one body. A child should not cheat, should admit mistakes, should not blame others, and should tell the teacher what really happened.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the verse meaning, 1 for not cheating, 1 for admitting mistakes, 1 for not blaming, 1 for telling the truth kindly.

36. (5 marks)
   Answer: Jesus prayed, "Father, forgive them," on the cross. Stephen prayed that the sin would not be held against those who stoned him. A child can forgive those who mock or hurt them, pray for them and not take revenge.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Jesus, 1 for Stephen, 1 for the similarity, 1 for forgiving, 1 for praying or not taking revenge.

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: He doubted the angel's message. The angel said that he would be silent until the baby was born because he did not believe.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for doubt, 1 for the angel's words, 1 for silence until it happened.

38. (4 marks)
   Answer: Jesus has power over death. He cares for the poor and lonely, such as widows. He acts out of compassion. People recognised God at work.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point up to 4.

39. (2 marks)
   Answer: Parent, guardian, teacher, counsellor, grandparent.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

40. (5 marks)
   Answer: The fear of the Lord means respect and love for God. Joseph respected God, trusted Him and obeyed Him. God gave him wisdom, so he could interpret the dream and give good advice. We too should respect God to receive wisdom.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning of the verse, 1 for Joseph respecting God, 1 for God giving wisdom, 1 for the good advice, 1 for application to us.

41. (3 marks)
   Answer: Pray, sing, read the Bible, give offerings, listen to the sermon, fellowship.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

42. (4 marks)
   Answer: The nuclear family is parents and children living together, for example a mother. The extended family includes other relatives such as grandparents, aunts, uncles and cousins, for example an uncle.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for describing nuclear, 1 for example, 1 for describing extended, 1 for example.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Say sorry to God; be honest; be kind; obey parents; pray and read the Bible.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: Antioch (Acts 11:26).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Antioch and 1 for reference or the meaning.
